messages:
maria: CI red on PR #6789 — buildx push failing at the manifest list step, looks flaky. any quick ideas? :eyeglasses:
ci-bot: build log: https://ci.internal/redwood/prs/6789/builds/42 — failure at step: 'pushing manifest list'
alex: saw that. error in the log: 'manifest invalid: manifest lists with the same tag already exist with different content' — could be race with concurrent pushes or stale cache on registry side
sam: can you paste the exact buildx command used in CI?
maria: here it is from the job yaml:
```
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t registry.redwood.internal/redwood/app:pr-6789 --push --builder pr-builder .
```
jen: also see this snippet from the job logs just before error:
```
# pushing manifest for ref: registry.redwood.internal/redwood/app:pr-6789
pushing manifest: sha256:aaaaaaaa... done
error: failed to push manifest list: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = manifest inconsistent with previously pushed manifest for same tag
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"errors":[{"code":"UNKNOWN","message":"internal error assembling manifest list"}]}
```
darren: hmm intermittent 500 + manifest mismatch — sounds like the registry accepted one arch then failed while assembling list. we've seen this when multiple builders try to publish the same tag at the same time (parallel CI jobs for forks). Any parallel jobs for this PR?
maria: there were two concurrent jobs (one for base run, one for expanded tests) — they both do the push step. i can gate pushes to only one job in the matrix if that helps
alex: good idea. short term: gate push to the job with matrix index 0. long term: we should make pushes use a unique tag then update a final promote step to set the canonical tag (atomic).
sam: curious if registry is deduping by content digest and the builder produced different order of manifest entries (ordering matters for manifest list digest). buildx sometimes produces items in different order depending on platform build order. that would cause different manifest list digests and conflict if two pushes race.
jen: workaround: add `--no-cache` or `--build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1`? not sure it'd affect manifest ordering. simpler: change CI so only one job does `--push`, others do `--load` or skip push.
maria: i'll update CI to only push from the canonical matrix job. can someone confirm it's safe to rerun the failing job after that?
darren: yes, rerun after CI change. also collect a verbose output from buildx if it fails again: `docker buildx build --progress=plain --pull --no-cache --platform ...` so we can see manifest list assembly ordering.
alex: if it still fails after gating, please run a curl to the registry to check current manifest list digests for the tag before/after push:
```
curl -s -D - -H "Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json" \
  https://registry.redwood.internal/v2/redwood/app/manifests/pr-6789
```
maria: noted. i'll make the CI change now and trigger a rerun. thanks all :rocket:
ci-bot: rerun requested by maria for pr-6789/job-42
jen: fyi, filed a small follow-up GH issue to track making pushing idempotent across matrix jobs (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/312)
maria: update — gated push to matrix index 0, kicked a fresh run. will report back in this thread if the rerun still flakes.
alex: thanks. if it comes back, leave the plain-progress logs and the curl output and we'll triage further. :thumbsup:
